usedFor: TimeRex holds scheduled events, and HubSpot records each booker through “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in TimeRex, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The note puts the booked meeting on the contact's record, so the next person knows it is coming.

watchOut: “Event Rescheduled” and “Event Cancelled” fire on later changes, so they can touch a contact already created.
